source_records.body: Fictional local record for Bramble seed ledger. The first preview contains the requested ledger columns. This record covers a local preview only.
I believe sharing for Bramble seed ledger is complete because the local preview finished.
Correction for Bramble seed ledger: use packet unit of single packets, replacing my initial value of dozens. This correction changes the recorded value, not the closed status of Bramble seed ledger.

Fictional execution receipt for Bramble seed ledger. The recorded command wrote a ledger preview to a local file for Bramble seed ledger. The recorded command did not perform sharing for Bramble seed ledger. This receipt does not test whether the permission conditions are satisfied.

For Bramble, you can share the ledger only after Omi accepts the dormancy note. For Bramble, permission to share the ledger also requires that the lot totals balance. Both conditions for permission to share the ledger in Bramble are necessary because an unbalanced lot obscures missing packets.

I accept the ledger columns for Bramble seed ledger. I close Bramble seed ledger. While closing Bramble seed ledger, I do not accept the Bramble dormancy note. At this review, cancel the Bramble dormancy note. There is no time for the dormancy note in this review window.
For the next step on Bramble seed ledger, hold the new lot for a manual count. Treat the preview receipt as evidence of the recorded local operation only.
In Opal, the seed display is independent of the Bramble seed ledger. For Opal seed display, keep display cards free of lot totals. I want the Opal seed display kept in planning until its own review.

For Bramble, open the seed ledger work item. For Bramble seed ledger, preserve the harvest-year field because older seeds need different storage. At this opening meeting, Bramble seed ledger is waiting for review. My initial instruction for Bramble seed ledger sets packet unit to dozens. The dormancy note is a separate follow-up to Bramble seed ledger.
Fictional status record for Opal seed display. Opal seed display remains in planning. No acceptance entry was written by this status query.
I will put the Bramble seed ledger preview beside the working notes. The folder label is draft café 5.

Reopen the Bramble dormancy note because the new seed lot needs cold storage. The Bramble dormancy note must record the cold-storage interval. The accepted Bramble seed ledger stays closed while the dormancy note is open.
This chat continues the same Bramble seed ledger work item opened in the first chat. The Bramble seed ledger constraint to preserve the harvest-year field still applies.

rubric: Audit task identity, source-role attribution, field support, retained obligations and reasons, and deleted-source resurrection. No automated stored-merge correctness claim is made.
